visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark brown hair, wearing a white face mask and a black hoodie with 'AUTHENTIC NEW YORK 388' printed in red and white, stands outdoors in front of a modern building with glass doors. He looks at the camera and speaks with active hand gestures. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a brightly lit jewelry store. The man walks towards a counter where an older shopkeeper in a plaid shirt is standing. Behind them, glass cases are filled with gold necklaces and pendants. (3) A middle-aged man in a patterned black jacket and a baseball cap enters the frame. He and the main character shake hands and pose for a photo. A female staff member is partially visible behind the counter. (4) The main character examines a red velvet jewelry box. Inside is a thick gold chain and a massive, ornate gold 'lock' medallion decorated with traditional dragon and tiger motifs and red tassels. (5) The man puts the large gold medallion around his neck over his hoodie, pointing at it while speaking excitedly. He then leaves the store. (6) The setting changes to an outdoor urban sidewalk with rows of parked scooters. The main character meets another man with bleached blond hair wearing a denim jacket with an LV monogram pattern. (7) They stand next to each other as the main character presents a red gift bag. The blond man opens a smaller gift box to reveal a gold necklace, then receives the large red box containing the massive medallion. (8) The blond man puts the large gold medallion over his neck, smiling and posing while the main character gestures towards the gift. The background shows city traffic and a bus passing by.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins over a rhythmic trap BGM with a bright synth lead and strong percussive beat. The speaker exhibits a high speech rate and excited pitch contour. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the move into the jewelry store. The main vocal continues with moderate conversational loudness, layered with subtle indoor room tone. (3) A second, calmer male voice briefly appears, followed by sounds of mutual laughter and a soft patting sound (handshake). BGM remains constant in the background. (4) Sound of a jewelry box clicking open and the crinkling of plastic packaging. The primary speaker's pitch rises as he reacts to the gold items. (5) Another 'whoosh' SFX signals the outdoor transition. Ambient urban noise floor becomes audible, including distant engine hum. (6) Interaction between two dominant male voices occurs; one is enthusiastic while the other expresses surprise with a loud vocal stinger ('What the fuck'). (7) Audible rustling of a paper gift bag and the sliding sound of a gift box being unboxed. The BGM maintains a high tempo to match the celebratory atmosphere. (8) Final laughter and high-arousal exclamations as the speakers admire the medallion, accompanied by a final rhythmic swell in the music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a social influencer's journey to purchase an extremely large and expensive traditional gold longevity lock as a birthday gift for a respected associate ('Yi Ge'), concluding with a personal delivery and the recipient's reaction.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently shows the jewelry store's branding on bags and boxes, praises the owner, and includes a specific promotional slogan for a basketball league performance.
